headline: As of 2026-10-19: 9,784,071 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 40 of 50 states, D+19.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 9,784,071 early/mail ballots cast so far across 40 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+19.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,399,377), Florida (924,352), Georgia (890,370).
